title: Juicy Sweet Zanzibari Dum Stir-fry
description: A sweet and juicy meal-prep Kenyan dish featuring white cornmeal dumplings with a savory vegetable base.

ingredients.name: 1 cup white cornmeal
ingredients.notes: Use fresh or frozen corn kernels for added sweetness.

ingredients.name: 3 cloves garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Can be replaced with 1 tablespoon garlic paste for quicker preparation.

instructions: Preheat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic to the pan; sauté until softened and translucent.
Stir in bell peppers and cook for another minute.
Add mixed vegetables and continue cooking until they begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
In separate bowl, mix cornmeal with a little water to form a batter. Gradually pour into the skillet while stirring continuously.
Cook dumplings on both sides until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove from heat and serve hot as a meal or for meal-prep use.
